description: The spec's headline claim is not reproduced by the on-disk artifact. Spec UPDATE-2 (lines 60-67) asserts 'top-25 open Algora bounties → 0 real-payable-uncontested-agent-doable right now' and says gate filter (d) USD-not-token was ADDED to drop the Rustchain token-farm. But state/gated.json on disk still lists Scottcjn/Rustchain#2239 as the ONE survivor, and its gate string is 'passed (funder-active, no-open-PR, real-repo>=50★)' WITHOUT the 'USD-not-token' clause that run.sh:107 now emits. This proves gated.json was generated by an OLDER gate() before filter (d) existed and was never regenerated. So the only evidence for 'inventory = 0' is spec prose; the actual committed state file contradicts it by still presenting a token-farm as attemptable. A fresh `EARN_MODE=gate` run is required to make the artifact match the claim (the run.sh:105 regex would now match 'social mining'/'earn rtc' in the title and drop it).
